subject: Cerebellar network timing supported episodic memory in older adults
script: From Agewell Brief: Cerebellar network timing supported episodic memory in older adults. New fMRI evidence shows that dynamic coordination of specialized cerebellar circuits with cerebral networks supports episodic memory in older adults—and that instability during encoding predicts future retrieval slowing. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
